parents.subject: LU-21192 osp: send the parent FID of new OST objects

commit.subject: LU-11628 lfsck: give OST objects a missing parent FID
commit.message:
LU-11628 lfsck: give OST objects a missing parent FID

Layout LFSCK checks the parent FID (trusted.fid) of each OST object
a layout references, but takes an object that has none as consistent.
Objects that were never written have none, unless the MDT that
created them sent it, so lfs fid2path cannot map them and a scan of
the OST cannot tell which file they belong to.

Repair such an object as an unmatched pair: set its parent FID, with
the stripe index and component, and its owner and project, from the
MDT-object that references it, but only if it still has none, so
that a write since the check, which also stores the layout version of
an FLR mirror, is not overwritten.  It is counted in
repaired_unmatched_pair.  The repair now checks, under the layout
lock, that the object is still where the request found it in the
layout, as the repair of a dangling object does, so that a layout
swap during the run cannot give it the wrong parent, and it no longer
changes the attributes the other stripes of the file are checked
against.  Objects of files changed since the run started are left,
since the MDT sends their parent FID once their creation commits.

Add sanity-lfsck test 15e.
